identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b3.1b][defect] Expose sealed authenticated Observatory authority projection

values.task_boundary: Own only the minimum authority-protocol and serving-authority interface necessary for the sealed projection plus focused tests.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Only replicated published authority plus the exact verified #272 cut can yield an unconstructible Observatory projection; callers cannot construct or substitute fields.

AC-2: Canonical JCS preimage under adl.observatory-serving-authority-binding.v1 binds trust-domain, polis, lineage, operation, committed log/foundation generation, OwnerCommit, fence, lease, and foundation state/result/receipt digests; reconstructed bytes must equal the verified artifact and its SHA-256.

AC-3: Published operation/log and every opaque #272 cut field must equal the canonical payload; independently valid but unrelated authority/cut pairing and every mismatch fail before projection output.

AC-4: A sealed quorum-basis snapshot binds configuration digest, voter generation/index, old and optional joint-new bounded sorted `(Guardian ID, certificate generation, boot generation)` entries plus thresholds/digests into durable result/retry truth; restore revalidates entry bounds/order/uniqueness, signer membership and generation eligibility, old/joint quorum, and inclusive deadline; legacy/corrupt state gains no authority and entries never enter the projection.
AC-5: Projection and errors are deterministic, bounded, and redacted with no raw signature, token, key, peer list, endpoint, secret, path, or provider material.

AC-6: Focused tests include noncanonical/equivalent JSON encodings, signer/quorum snapshot restore mutation, and the A/B authority by A/B cut 2x2 matrix; strict Clippy, exact scope/diff proof, fresh exact-head review, required CI, and typed finish pass before #274 resumes.
dependencies: #274 remains initialized and blocked on terminal ancestral #350
non_goals: UI, listener, transport, cloud, provider, deployment, or paid runners
